```{r}
# ============================================================
# Two-patch herbivore-vegetation model:
# full system (2), reduced system on M0 (11),
# and reduced system on M_epsilon (19)
#
# Numerical exploration for different migration intensity alpha2
# and toxicity beta = im/(4G)
# ============================================================

# Install if needed:
# install.packages(c("deSolve", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "tidyr", "patchwork"))

library(deSolve)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================================
# 1. Parameters from manuscript
# ============================================================
parms <- list(
  K1 = 150,
  K2 = 100,
  r  = 0.2,
  c0 = 0.175,   # original conversion constant before nondimensionalization
  im = 0.75,
  vu = 10,
  b  = 20,

  # User-editable because not fully visible in the manuscript snippet
  mu1 = 0.06,   # dimensional herbivore mortality
  G   = 1.50,   # toxicity tolerance parameter

  # Migration settings
  alpha1_dim = 0.15,   # dimensional alpha1
  alpha2_dim = 0.25,   # dimensional alpha2
  eps = 0.10           # small parameter
)

# ============================================================
# 2. Convert to nondimensional parameters used in the model
# ============================================================
make_nd_parms <- function(parms, alpha2_dim = NULL, beta_override = NULL, eps_override = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(alpha2_dim)) parms$alpha2_dim <- alpha2_dim
  if (!is.null(eps_override)) parms$eps <- eps_override

  b1   <- parms$b / parms$K1
  b2   <- parms$b / parms$K2
  eta  <- parms$im / parms$r
  c    <- parms$c0 * parms$im / parms$r
  a1   <- parms$alpha1_dim / parms$r
  a2   <- parms$alpha2_dim / parms$r
  k1   <- 1 / parms$K1
  k2   <- 1 / parms$K2
  mu   <- parms$mu1 / parms$r
  beta <- if (is.null(beta_override)) parms$im / (4 * parms$G) else beta_override
  rho1 <- parms$vu / parms$K1
  rho2 <- parms$vu / parms$K2

  list(
    b1 = b1, b2 = b2, eta = eta, c = c,
    alpha1 = a1, alpha2 = a2, k1 = k1, k2 = k2,
    mu = mu, beta = beta, rho1 = rho1, rho2 = rho2,
    eps = parms$eps
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 3. Helper functions
# ============================================================
Cfun <- function(v, b, rho, beta) {
  1 - beta * (v - rho) / (b + v - rho)
}

m1_fun <- function(v1, p) p$alpha1 / (p$k1 + v1)
m2_fun <- function(v2, p) p$alpha2 / (p$k2 + v2)

hstar_M0 <- function(v1, v2, H, p) {
  m1 <- m1_fun(v1, p)
  m2 <- m2_fun(v2, p)
  (m2 / (m1 + m2)) * H
}

psi_Meps <- function(v1, v2, H, p) {
  m1 <- m1_fun(v1, p)
  m2 <- m2_fun(v2, p)
  H0 <- (m2 / (m1 + m2)) * H
  corr <- 1 + (p$eps / (m1 + m2)) *
    (p$c * Cfun(v1, p$b1, p$rho1, p$beta) * (v1 - p$rho1) / (p$b1 + v1 - p$rho1) - p$mu)
  H0 * corr
}

# ============================================================
# 4. Full model
# state = c(v1, v2, h1, H)
# ============================================================
full_model <- function(t, state, p) {
  v1 <- state["v1"]
  v2 <- state["v2"]
  h1 <- state["h1"]
  H  <- state["H"]

  C1 <- Cfun(v1, p$b1, p$rho1, p$beta)
  C2 <- Cfun(v2, p$b2, p$rho2, p$beta)

  dv1 <- v1 * (1 - v1) -
    p$eta * (v1 - p$rho1) * h1 / (p$b1 + v1 - p$rho1) * C1

  dv2 <- v2 * (1 - v2) -
    p$eta * (v2 - p$rho2) * (H - h1) / (p$b2 + v2 - p$rho2) * C2

  dh1 <- C1 * p$c * (v1 - p$rho1) * h1 / (p$b1 + v1 - p$rho1) -
    p$mu * h1 +
    (1 / p$eps) * (p$alpha2 * (H - h1) / (p$k2 + v2) - p$alpha1 * h1 / (p$k1 + v1))

  dH <- C1 * p$c * (v1 - p$rho1) * h1 / (p$b1 + v1 - p$rho1) +
    C2 * p$c * (v2 - p$rho2) * (H - h1) / (p$b2 + v2 - p$rho2) -
    p$mu * H

  list(c(dv1, dv2, dh1, dH))
}

# ============================================================
# Fast subsystem eigenvalue heatmap
# ============================================================

p_fast <- make_nd_parms(
  parms,
  alpha2_dim = 0.25,
  beta_override = 0.125
)

v1_grid <- seq(0.05, 1.20, length.out = 250)
v2_grid <- seq(0.05, 1.20, length.out = 250)

fast_df <- expand.grid(
  v1 = v1_grid,
  v2 = v2_grid
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    m1 = p_fast$alpha1 / (p_fast$k1 + v1),
    m2 = p_fast$alpha2 / (p_fast$k2 + v2),
    lambda_fast = -(m1 + m2),
    spectral_gap = -lambda_fast
  )

min_gap <- min(fast_df$spectral_gap, na.rm = TRUE)

p_fast_eig <- ggplot(
  fast_df,
  aes(x = v2, y = v1, fill = lambda_fast)
) +
  geom_raster(interpolate = TRUE) +
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    #name = expression(lambda[f])
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = 1.03,
    y = 0.16,
    label = paste0(
      "lambda[f] < 0 throughout\n",
      "min(-lambda[f]) = ", round(min_gap, 2)
    ),
    parse = FALSE,
    size = 4
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(v[2]),
    y = expression(v[1])
  )

print(p_fast_eig)

ggsave(
  "~/Downloads/Esraa Alam/scripts.R/results2/fast_eigenvalues_heatmap.pdf",
  p_fast_eig,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 5.2
)

ggsave(
  "~/Downloads/Esraa Alam/scripts.R/results2/fast_eigenvalues_heatmap.png",
  p_fast_eig,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 5.2,
  dpi = 300
)
# ============================================================
# 5. Reduced model on M0
# state = c(v1, v2, H)
# ============================================================
reduced_M0 <- function(t, state, p) {
  v1 <- state["v1"]
  v2 <- state["v2"]
  H  <- state["H"]

  h1s <- hstar_M0(v1, v2, H, p)
  C1 <- Cfun(v1, p$b1, p$rho1, p$beta)
  C2 <- Cfun(v2, p$b2, p$rho2, p$beta)

  dv1 <- v1 * (1 - v1) -
    p$eta * (v1 - p$rho1) * h1s / (p$b1 + v1 - p$rho1) * C1

  dv2 <- v2 * (1 - v2) -
    p$eta * (v2 - p$rho2) * (H - h1s) / (p$b2 + v2 - p$rho2) * C2

  dH <- C1 * p$c * (v1 - p$rho1) * h1s / (p$b1 + v1 - p$rho1) +
    C2 * p$c * (v2 - p$rho2) * (H - h1s) / (p$b2 + v2 - p$rho2) -
    p$mu * H

  list(c(dv1, dv2, dH))
}

# ============================================================
# 6. Reduced model on M_epsilon
# state = c(v1, v2, H)
# ============================================================
reduced_Meps <- function(t, state, p) {
  v1 <- state["v1"]
  v2 <- state["v2"]
  H  <- state["H"]

  psi <- psi_Meps(v1, v2, H, p)
  C1  <- Cfun(v1, p$b1, p$rho1, p$beta)
  C2  <- Cfun(v2, p$b2, p$rho2, p$beta)

  dv1 <- v1 * (1 - v1) -
    p$eta * (v1 - p$rho1) * psi / (p$b1 + v1 - p$rho1) * C1

  dv2 <- v2 * (1 - v2) -
    p$eta * (v2 - p$rho2) * (H - psi) / (p$b2 + v2 - p$rho2) * C2

  dH <- C1 * p$c * (v1 - p$rho1) * psi / (p$b1 + v1 - p$rho1) +
    C2 * p$c * (v2 - p$rho2) * (H - psi) / (p$b2 + v2 - p$rho2) -
    p$mu * H

  list(c(dv1, dv2, dH))
}

# ============================================================
# 7. Simulation wrapper
# ============================================================
run_case <- function(alpha2_dim, beta_val, parms,
                     times = seq(0, 80, by = 0.05),
                     y0_full = c(v1 = 0.10, v2 = 0.10, h1 = 0.02, H = 0.02),
                     atol = 1e-9, rtol = 1e-8) {

  p <- make_nd_parms(parms, alpha2_dim = alpha2_dim, beta_override = beta_val)

  # Full model
  out_full <- as.data.frame(ode(
    y = y0_full, times = times, func = full_model, parms = p,
    method = "lsoda", atol = atol, rtol = rtol
  ))

  # Reduced M0 initial state: use unname() so column names remain exactly v1, v2, H
  y0_M0 <- c(
    v1 = unname(y0_full["v1"]),
    v2 = unname(y0_full["v2"]),
    H  = unname(y0_full["H"])
  )

  out_M0 <- as.data.frame(ode(
    y = y0_M0, times = times, func = reduced_M0, parms = p,
    method = "lsoda", atol = atol, rtol = rtol
  ))

  # Reduced Meps initial state
  y0_Meps <- c(
    v1 = unname(y0_full["v1"]),
    v2 = unname(y0_full["v2"]),
    H  = unname(y0_full["H"])
  )

  out_Meps <- as.data.frame(ode(
    y = y0_Meps, times = times, func = reduced_Meps, parms = p,
    method = "lsoda", atol = atol, rtol = rtol
  ))

  # Add metadata
  out_full$model  <- "Full"
  out_M0$model    <- "Reduced M0"
  out_Meps$model  <- "Reduced Meps"

  out_full$alpha2_dim <- alpha2_dim
  out_M0$alpha2_dim   <- alpha2_dim
  out_Meps$alpha2_dim <- alpha2_dim

  out_full$beta <- beta_val
  out_M0$beta   <- beta_val
  out_Meps$beta <- beta_val

  list(full = out_full, M0 = out_M0, Meps = out_Meps)
}

# ============================================================
# 8. Explore migration intensity and toxicity
# ============================================================
alpha2_vals <- c(0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75)
beta_vals   <- c(0.08, 0.16) #0.12, 0.16, 0.20)

cases <- list()
k <- 1
for (a2 in alpha2_vals) {
  for (bval in beta_vals) {
    cases[[k]] <- run_case(alpha2_dim = a2, beta_val = bval, parms = parms)
    k <- k + 1
    k
  }
}

all_full <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(cases, `[[`, "full"))
all_M0   <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(cases, `[[`, "M0"))
all_Meps <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(cases, `[[`, "Meps"))

# ============================================================
# 9. Check column names if needed
# ============================================================
cat("Columns in all_full:\n")
print(colnames(all_full))

cat("Columns in all_M0:\n")
print(colnames(all_M0))

cat("Columns in all_Meps:\n")
print(colnames(all_Meps))

# ============================================================
# 10. Convert to long format for plotting
# ============================================================
full_long <- all_full |>
  dplyr::select(time, v1, v2, H, alpha2_dim, beta, model) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(v1, v2, H), names_to = "state", values_to = "value")

M0_long <- all_M0 |>
  dplyr::select(time, v1, v2, H, alpha2_dim, beta, model) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(v1, v2, H), names_to = "state", values_to = "value")

Meps_long <- all_Meps |>
  dplyr::select(time, v1, v2, H, alpha2_dim, beta, model) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(v1, v2, H), names_to = "state", values_to = "value")

all_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(full_long, M0_long, Meps_long)

# ============================================================
# 11. Publication-quality trajectory grid
# ============================================================

all_long$alpha_label <- paste0("alpha2 = ", all_long$alpha2_dim)
all_long$beta_label  <- paste0("beta = ", all_long$beta)
all_long$scenario <- paste0(
  "α₂=", all_long$alpha2_dim,
  "\nβ=", all_long$beta
)

p_traj <- ggplot(all_long,
                 aes(x = time, y = value,
                     color = model,
                     linetype = model)) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +

  facet_grid(
    state ~ alpha_label + beta_label,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Full" = "#E64B35",

    "Reduced Meps" = "#00A087"
  )) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.spacing = unit(0.7, "lines")
  ) +

  labs(
    #title = "Dynamics of the full and reduced models across migration and toxicity regimes",
    x = "Time",
    y = "State value"
  )

print(p_traj)

# ============================================================
# 12. Approximation error of reduced systems vs full model
# ============================================================
compare_error <- function(full_df, red_df) {
  merged <- full_df |>
    dplyr::select(time, v1_full = v1, v2_full = v2, H_full = H) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(
      red_df |> dplyr::select(time, v1_red = v1, v2_red = v2, H_red = H),
      by = "time"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      err_v1 = abs(v1_full - v1_red),
      err_v2 = abs(v2_full - v2_red),
      err_H  = abs(H_full - H_red)
    )

  dplyr::summarise(
    merged,
    max_err_v1 = max(err_v1, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_err_v2 = max(err_v2, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_err_H  = max(err_H,  na.rm = TRUE),
    rmse_v1    = sqrt(mean(err_v1^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    rmse_v2    = sqrt(mean(err_v2^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    rmse_H     = sqrt(mean(err_H^2,  na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

err_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(cases, function(z) {
  e0 <- compare_error(z$full, z$M0)
  ee <- compare_error(z$full, z$Meps)

  dplyr::bind_rows(
    dplyr::mutate(
      e0,
      alpha2_dim = unique(z$full$alpha2_dim),
      beta = unique(z$full$beta),
      model = "Reduced M0",
      .before = 1
    ),
    dplyr::mutate(
      ee,
      alpha2_dim = unique(z$full$alpha2_dim),
      beta = unique(z$full$beta),
      model = "Reduced Meps",
      .before = 1
    )
  )
}))

print(err_tbl)
```
